definitions.gloss: herb; aromatic herb; fragrant plant used in cooking
definitions.explanation: A plant with aromatic leaves or stems used for flavoring food. Refers to culinary herbs like parsley, basil, cilantro, and rosemary. The word emphasizes the fragrant quality of the plant.

notes:
Combines ⟦{香|こう}→香：17307_kou⟧ (fragrance, aroma) and {草|そう} (grass, plant). Literally "fragrant plant."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {香草|こうそう}{焼|や}き: herb-grilled (a common cooking style)
- {香草|こうそう}⟦パン{粉|こ}→パン粉：04926_panko⟧{焼|や}き: herb breadcrumb bake
- {香草|こうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{添|そ}える→添える：13315_soeru⟧: to garnish with herbs
- {香草|こうそう}⟦ソース→ソース：17673_soosu⟧: herb sauce
- {香草|こうそう}⟦バター→バター：04671_bataa⟧: herb butter

USAGE:
{香草|こうそう} is the standard Japanese word for culinary herbs. It appears frequently on restaurant menus (especially for Western and Mediterranean dishes) and in recipe descriptions. {香草|こうそう}{焼|や}き (herb-grilled) is one of the most common preparations. Note that {香草|こうそう} specifically refers to aromatic herbs for cooking — it does not cover medicinal herbs.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ハーブ→ハーブ：11246_haabu⟧: herb (loanword) — the English loanword, used interchangeably in casual contexts and on product labels
- ⟦{薬草|やくそう}→薬草：14033_yakusou⟧: medicinal herb — herbs used for medicine, not cooking
- ⟦スパイス→スパイス：11054_supaisu⟧: spice — dried seeds, bark, or roots used for flavoring, distinct from fresh leafy herbs
